## Context
Story: 5ed3-9eb5-b841-4b5f — Update project docs to reflect dso.workflow config consolidation
Parent epic: 3b8b-d7e1-eeff-4796

## What to do
Update INSTALL.md, WORKTREE-GUIDE.md, CI-INTEGRATION.md, and dso-config.reference.conf to reference `dso.workflow` as the canonical config entry point.

Files to update:
- `INSTALL.md` — any references to merge.strategy, enforcement.strategy, worktree.isolation_enabled, attribution.enabled should note dso.workflow as the canonical key
- `plugins/dso/docs/WORKTREE-GUIDE.md` — update config examples to show dso.workflow
- `plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md` — update config examples to show dso.workflow=ci-pr instead of merge.strategy=pr + enforcement.strategy=ci
- `plugins/dso/config/dso-config.reference.conf` — add dso.workflow as the primary key at the top; mark legacy keys as deprecated comments

## Testing mode
GREEN — doc-only change, no executable behavior

## Done Definitions (from story)
- INSTALL.md, WORKTREE-GUIDE.md, CI-INTEGRATION.md, and dso-config.reference.conf are updated to reference dso.workflow as the canonical config entry point

## Notes
- Do NOT edit CLAUDE.md directly; deliver proposed CLAUDE.md changes as CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report
- Follow doc-router.md gates before writing
